query: select f.id, f.created_at from formation_players fp join formations f on f.id = fp.formation_id where fp.player_id = $1 and not exists ( select 1 from match_reports mr where mr.formation_id = f.id and mr.player_id = $1 ) and not exists ( select 1 from formation_events e where e.formation_id = f.id and e.kind = any($2) ) order by f.created_at, f.id
